test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 2 (Held On: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Given below are four sentences which are jumbled. Pick the option that gives their correct order.**

A. These thunderstorms were a huge relief after the heat wave conditions the region had experienced.

B. The Weather Department forecasts more storms in the coming days.

C. Thunderstorms and strong winds were reported in Northern India.

D. The Weather Department has also said monsoon is likely to hit South India soon.
solution:
The correct answer is 'CABD'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Once we go through the sentences, it can be assessed that the whole detail is about thunderstorms.

 
 
• The very first sentence that is stating the reported detail of thunderstorms is 'C' (**Thunderstorms and strong winds were reported in Northern India).**
 
• What happened next can be seen in the sentence 'A' (**These thunderstorms were a huge relief after the heat wave conditions the region had experienced).**
 
• Now the **weather department forecasts **can be seen in the sentence 'B' (**The Weather Department forecasts more storms in the coming day).**
 
• So obviously the last sentence must be 'D' (**The Weather Department has also said monsoon is likely to hit South India soon**).
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

Let's understand the meaning of some given words.

 
• Thunderstorm - a storm with loud rumbling and lightning and sometimes heavy rain.
 
• Forecast - to predict or estimate.
 
• Reported - formally or officially announced.
